judgment: the sacrificial ladle is not dropped.
image: So the noble one, in fear and trembling,
lines: afterwards there is laughter and talk.
Thunder comes, and there is danger.
He loses a hundred thousand cowries —
he climbs to the nine mounds.
Do not chase them: in seven days he gets them back.
Thunder goes and comes, and there is danger.
Of his hundred thousand, nothing is lost.
There is work for him to do.
In the thunder he shrinks back, his eyes darting.
Thunder not at his body, at his neighbour's: no harm.

notes.name_en: 震 doubled thunder trigram; the thing named, not Wilhelm's 'The Arousing (Shock, Thunder)'.
notes.judgment: 匕鬯 the ladle and aromatic sacrificial wine, held steady through the shock.
notes.L2: 億 a vast count ('a hundred thousand' cowrie money); same measure in L5, kept identical.
notes.L3: 震蘇蘇，震行無眚 kept as two statements (no causal/conditional link supplied); 眚 harm as in the 無咎 family.
notes.L6: 震不于其躬，于其鄰 locates the thunder （于 'at'); no 'strikes' and no 'only'; 婚媾有言 talk kept as a separate tag.
